## Achados Verificados da Review

A triagem automática validou **7 achados** (6 confirmados, 1 precisa de contexto). Apresentados ordenados por severidade:

| Arquivo | Linha | Símbolo | Severidade | Achado |
|---------|-------|---------|-----------|---------|
| `packages/api-go/cmd/server/main.go` | 160 | `MountFiado` | **HIGH** | sqlc code not generated: `fiado.sql.go` missing. `queries (*db.Queries)` does not implement `PendingStore` interface methods. **Will not compile until sqlc is run.** |

| `packages/api-go/internal/fiado/pending.go` | 94 | `numericFloat` | **MED** | Silently returns `0.0` on conversion error or NULL value without logging; inconsistent with integration test pattern which validates and fails. **Masks data issues in production.** |
| `packages/api-go/internal/handler/fiado.go` | 62 | `writeFiadoFailure` | **MED** | Non-AppError exceptions silently masked as generic `INTERNAL_ERROR` without logging actual error. **Violates AGENTS.md guidance**: "log at process or handler boundaries". Impedes production debugging. |
| `packages/api-go/internal/fiado/pending.go` | 77 | `timestamptzTime` | **MED** | Discards bool indicating timestamp validity. If NULL (should not happen per schema), zero `time.Time` used silently without indication of data integrity issue. |

| `packages/api-go/internal/fiado/pending_test.go` | 234 | `assertAppError` | **LOW** | ⚠️ **Precisa de contexto**: No test case for non-AppError thrown from service (`writeFiadoFailure` silent masking). Test coverage gap for handler error path. |
